VERIFIED.ordinary_theorem: For the original real compact bump eta, the actual source and corrected compressed packets satisfy Q(g_T)/(T^4 log T)->C and Q(g_prime_T)/(T^4 log T)->8C, C>0. Thus Q(g_prime_T)>Q(g_T)>0 eventually. For any fixed M>=1 and L>0, such a counterexample exists with both packets inside the window L and the same valid cutoff M; the actual integral of -Delta against that packet density is negative. The actual critical-line mass satisfies N(g_T)/T^4->C_epsilon>0, while the integral of -Delta divided by N(g_T) tends to -infinity. No fixed finite m or bounded slack can make the corresponding universal certificate conclusion true. For general fixed compression s>1, the compressed/original high-frequency ratio tends to s^3; any uniform constant-amplitude nonincrease would require |c|^2<=s^(-3).
